item.title: Show HN: Summarize any page into a pod episode
item.summary: I've been working on thedaily.fm basically to "Podcast anything". I just added a Chrome extension to capture any page, summarize it, and create an episode in your pod. I use it when I want to know something but don't have time to read, will never bookmark and come back, but will listen to a 60-second summary when I'm on the go.
